description: List the brand's LinkedIn/X long-form articles, optionally filtered by platform and status. short {id,platform,title,status}; medium adds wordCount, targetKeyword, publishedUrl, createdAt; full = raw (includes bodies). Use get_social_article for the paste kit.

detail.description: Verbosity of returned item(s): "short" = id + primary label + status (cheap list scan); "medium" = key summary fields + counts (a useful glance); "full" = the complete object. Default "short". Lists default to "short" — to zoom into one item, call its get/view tool with detail="medium" or "full".

name: list_social_articles
